items.title: Chelating polymer host
items.text: Chelex 100 is an Analytical Grade, 200–400 mesh styrene–divinylbenzene copolymer supplied by Bio-Rad. Its iminodiacetate groups, –CH₂N(CH₂COO⁻)₂, bind Cd²⁺. The cited manufacturer capacity is 2.0 mequiv/g for dry resin or 0.4 mequiv/mL for wet resin. These are host charge-capacity values, not nanocrystal yields. The actual product is CdS embedded in this host, rather than isolated CdS powder.
